Vendor / hibob pricing

HiBob pricing in 2026

HiBob publishes no price for Bob: the pricing page is a quote request, and the price is set by the modules you take (Core HR, Performance, Compensation, Surveys and others) and your headcount. For scale, the vendors in this category that do publish list an HRIS seat at $3 to $29 per employee per month, with BambooHR, the vendor HiBob is most often compared with, at $10, $17 and $25. Get each HiBob module priced as its own line and set the quote against those figures in the ledger.

How the price is built

US payroll is not native to Bob: it connects to a payroll provider, so price the payroll provider alongside the HiBob quote.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your HiBob quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

Does HiBob publish its prices?

No. The pricing page asks for company details and routes to a quote. HiBob does not publish a per-employee rate, a module price, a seat minimum or a renewal term.

How is a HiBob quote built?

From the modules you choose on top of Core HR, and your headcount. Ask for each module as a separate per-employee line, any platform fee, the implementation fee, and the renewal cap, so the quote can be compared with a vendor that publishes.

Does HiBob run US payroll?

Not natively in Bob: US payroll runs through a connected payroll provider. Price that provider alongside the HiBob quote, or the comparison with an all-in-one vendor is not like-for-like.

How does HiBob compare with BambooHR on cost?

BambooHR publishes Core $10, Pro $17 and Elite $25 per employee per month above 25 employees. HiBob does not publish, so the comparison needs a HiBob quote at your headcount with the modules matched to the BambooHR plan you would buy.
